reasoning: 驗證目標：GameZone Favorites 清單可設定至多十支隊伍。為什麼這樣切：條款給的是容量上限，故取邊界內側觀察——第十支必須被接受且十支同時在清單中；上限外側的拒絕行為屬 164 的條款（§8.2.1），本 leaf 不斷言第十一支被拒，以免兩列的失敗條件重疊。

tcs.tc_title: Ten teams can be held in the GameZone favorites list
tcs.test_item: The HU shall have the capability to set up to a maximum of ten teams to the GameZone Favorites list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. No team is set as a GameZone favorite
5. At least ten different teams are available
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Add nine different teams to the GameZone favorites and read the list
2. Add a tenth different team
3. Read the GameZone favorites list
tcs.expected_result:
1. The list holds nine teams
2. The tenth team is accepted
3. The list holds ten teams and all ten are the teams added
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
